searchText: Just for a note: it could be great to have some of the nodes running on legacy CPUs next devnet We mainly use Digital ocean for running the devnets, i dont think you have fine grained control on what CPU you end up with there. Is there some cloud provider and CPU type you wanted us to integrate? Could we get minimal presets working for the EL clients? It uses a different trusted setup with a smaller FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB. I looked at geth and it would need some work to support. I'm not sure about the other ELs. these are hardcoded at kzg lib level, unless there is a kzg lib with minimal preset this wouldn't be possible <asn_d6> you can compile c-kzg with minimal preset <asn_d6> see `FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB` in its makefile <asn_d6> https://github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/blob/main/src/Makefile#L23 <asn_d6> or the bindings here https://github.com/ethereum/c-kzg-4844/blob/main/bindings/rust/src/bindings/mod.rs#L575 4th gen Intel CPUs like 4790k will fail in case ckzg is compiled with adx support <@206016661470314496> might be you have some specific cloud providers in mind? Gotcha, the way geth accesses the API then should be safe then as long as I compile minimal support with c-kzg and use a minimal trusted_setup? I'll need to check how geth loads the trusted_setup for ckzg. Not sure if geth initializes the trusted_setup or if c-kzg does. Do you know if anyone is doing this on any of the other ELs? We'll need these to be runtime selectable to pass spectests when they are available, or are spec tests going to be made on one preset only? <gakonst> > <gakonst> replying to: ```@testing4844_bot wrote: <FLCL> Just for a note: it could be great to have some of the nodes running on legacy CPUs next devnet``` This is a very interesting point. Are you worried about DoS on lower end machines due to the math?
